description: List bank transactions. Paginated. Returns brief view by default; pass view='full' or call get_transaction for full detail. The brief view's direction comes from a signed CAMT/Wise marker (unknown without one); the read-back type is always "C" and is not a direction.

accounts_dimensions_id.description: Filter by bank account dimension ID (client-side)

amount_max.description: Only transactions whose EUR-equivalent amount (base_amount ?? amount) <= this

amount_min.description: Only transactions whose EUR-equivalent amount (base_amount ?? amount) >= this

date_from.description: Only transactions with date >= this (YYYY-MM-DD). Narrowed server-side.

date_to.description: Only transactions with date <= this (YYYY-MM-DD). Narrowed server-side.

has_bank_ref.description: true = only transactions with a bank_ref_number; false = only without

modified_since.description: Return only objects modified since this timestamp (ISO 8601)

per_page.description: Items per page (default 100, max 500); applies only when a client-side filter (amount/bank-ref/dimension) is active.

status.description: Filter by status: PROJECT, CONFIRMED, or VOID. Narrowed server-side.

type.description: Filter by statement direction: D = incoming, C = outgoing, read from the signed CAMT/Wise marker (client-side). Rows without a marker are left out and counted in direction_unknown_excluded.

view.description: Response detail: brief (default) returns triage fields; full returns every API field.

name: list_transactions
title: List Transactions
